in_hebrew.name: Housen
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו House of God
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Housen הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the ancient Greek word 'hōsios' meaning 'holy' or 'godlike'. The name Housen is a reminder of our spiritual connection to the divine and our role as stewards of the house of God.

in_greek.name: Housen
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει House of God
in_greek.long_meaning: Housen είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the ancient Greek word 'hōsios' meaning 'holy' or 'godlike'. The name Housen is a reminder of our spiritual connection to the divine and our role as stewards of the house of God.

in_latin.name: Housen
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat House of God
in_latin.long_meaning: Housen est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the ancient Greek word 'hōsios' meaning 'holy' or 'godlike'. The name Housen is a reminder of our spiritual connection to the divine and our role as stewards of the house of God.
